# ptasm 0.1

**Status:** Completed (0.1.1), 2026-11-10.

0.1.1 is the first public release of the assembler alone: no silent
errors, a cpu.json format others can write against, Intel and AT&T
syntax, `bin`/`hex`/`srec`/`elf` output (32- and 64-bit ELF), and the
documentation to use and change it. Its Epics are completed one at a
time, in this order. The Tickets' own write-ups and the release's
log of issues are kept with the project and published later.

## Releases

- **0.1.1** (2026-11-10): E1-E8, but E8.A4 (the docs pass), moved to 0.1.2.
- **0.1.2** (2026-11-16): E2.A8, E8.A4 and E8.A8-A9; from 0.2, E4.A3 (installing) and E8.T1, A1-A2 (fuzzing) (`README-02.md`).
- **0.1.3** (2026-11-17): the last 0.1 release: from 0.2, test depth, small CLI additions, `-g`, and debugging under QEMU and Renode (`README-03.md`).
